chunks: And whatever the camels eat, there is no harm in removing it.

key_terms.يَنْزِعَهُ: to remove it or pull it away

ai.seo_question: Is there any harm in removing what the camels eat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal allowance concerning something eaten by camels, stating that there is no harm in removing it. In context, it indicates permissibility and the absence of blame or restriction in this matter.
